links.surface: أبو حفص عمر بن محمد المعروف بابن الزيات

notes: «8 -» is the report number; the laqab «المعروف بابن الزيات» is kept as written; «عليهما السلام» and «عليهم السلام» are blessings and are left out
«أبي موسى بن جعفر» and the other «أبي» names: a relation word directly before a name gives the name alone (rule 1), so the five father-links are surfaces of the names only
«قال: قال أمير المؤمنين» names the source of the saying, linked (rule 2)
after the saying, «وأنشدني أبو الفرج البرقي الداودي» starts a second transmission (a poem with its own «أنشدني شيخ» line), which is after the saying (rule 9) and is not a route here
